Kitchen Tanks Emptying Plan – Saturday, October 3rd. 

The 1st shift leader will stop adding chocolate to the tanks at 12:00 PM. At that time, the target levels will be: Buffer Tank 85%, Melting Tank 2 85%, and New Melting Tank 100%. Based on our estimate, this amount of chocolate should provide approximately 7 hours of runtime, with the goal of allowing 2nd shift to empty the tanks. During a previous changeover, 3rd shift had to finish running the remaining chocolate. One possible contributor was that trim continued to be added for remelt throughout 2nd shift, which increased the amount of chocolate in the Buffer Tank. For this changeover, 2nd shift will need to determine when to stop remelting trim so the Buffer Tank can continue decreasing as planned. If anyone believes the estimated runtime or tank levels should be adjusted, please share your feedback so we can determine the best timing. The goal is to get as close as possible to the correct amount of chocolate for 2nd shift to empty the tanks. Rose Smuin Rich Brierley Tyson Fausett Phillip Perez Bojana McLeod Marcos Montano

Grey Boscan
